home.eyebrow: Independent guidance for citizen services in Bangladesh
home.copy: Prepare for birth registration, NID, e-Passport and driving licence applications with confidence. ShebaShathi BD brings required documents, procedural steps and official fee information together in clear language, with verification dates and direct links to government portals.
home.cta_sub: Free to use · No account required
home.note: Sourced from official portals · Verification dates included

intake.title: Tell us what you need, in your own words
intake.copy: Write in Bangla, English, or Banglish. We will match the service and task, ask only what is missing, and build a checklist from verified sources.
intake.label: Describe your situation
intake.placeholder: Example: My 5-year-old child needs a passport. The child does not have a NID.
intake.privacy: Do not type NID, passport, phone, or OTP numbers. Your description is not stored.
intake.example3: NID correction for my father's name

intake.review: We filled in what we found. Change anything that is wrong.
